answer: Each agent publishes the challenge hash in a DNSSEC-signed zone under its domain within 10 minutes, with signed record and DS record, spiralling through each RRSIG link to the root anchor at the zenith. Peers validate the chain and timestamp, rejecting breaks in the tundra of unsigned delegations. One honest agent holds 1 signed domain, $12 per year, for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must hold 10, so costs rise 10X. A broken chain, missing DS record, or late timestamp slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes offenders.
